why: The false-positive class "defect searched recursively, defense searched only at the root". The rule swept `components/ui/` at any depth and checked `components.json` only in `r.dir`: measured, prumo, ducado and LinhaK were the three accused of imitating the convention while all three had the file tracked in a subfolder (apps/web/, apps/web/, web/). Five of the twelve audited repositories are monorepos, and the accusation landed precisely on them. The two trees are identical except for `apps/web/components.json`. The `apps/loja/components.json` is on BOTH sides on purpose: it makes the proof immune to the lazy fix — swapping "only at the root" for "exists anywhere" would make the `fail` side exit 0, because a sibling package's `components.json` would start defending `apps/web/`. Only proximity matching, walking up the tree from the UI folder, makes both sides come out right.

commits.mensagem: monorepo sem components.json no pacote da UI
